<title level="1" right="Spell 3" pfs="Standard">
[Cloud Dragon's Cloak](/Spells.aspx?ID=1314)
<actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 70

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

**Trigger** You or an ally in range is targeted by a ranged attack.

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

**Target** the creature targeted by the attack
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 round
</row>

</column>

---

A cloud of mist enshrouds the target, appearing much like the deflecting clouds created by cloud dragons. The target is treated as [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=22) for the purposes of resolving the triggering attack (so normally the attacker must succeed at a DC 11 flat check to target it) and all ranged attacks against it for the duration.
name: Cloud Dragon's Cloak
